name: blocked-invoice-resolution-workflow
description: Daily automated workflow that retrieves all blocked supplier invoices from S/4HANA, enriches each with PO details, goods receipt status, Ariba contract terms, and cost center manager identity, then invokes an AI agent to classify the block reason and recommend a resolution. Invoices within the 2% variance tolerance are auto-released; all others are routed to the cost center manager via Outlook email and SAP Task Center for approval. Post-decision, approved invoices are released in S/4HANA and rejected invoices trigger an AP team notification.

parameters.content:
⚠️ **Daily Scheduler Required**

This workflow is triggered via webhook. An external scheduler (e.g. SAP BTP Job Scheduler) must call this endpoint once daily.

No native schedule trigger is available on this n8n instance.

🤖 **AI Agent: blocked-invoice-resolution-agent**

This node invokes the in-solution AI agent to classify the block reason and recommend a resolution action (auto_release / escalate / manual_review).
